sn55.46:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparayāno ||
sn55.46:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || ||
sn55.46:2.6: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 4.
sn55.46:2.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 1. Kapilavatthu
